text: Our elders set this day aside to help us turn our attention inward — away from our usual appetites and towards remembrance.
The true intention was never an empty stomach, but rather the quiet space it created for deeper reflection.
Today, you might choose to chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' while going about your daily work, or perhaps read a few names from the Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and take one still minute in front of it, allowing for a moment of peace.
